title: eng-security
text:
eng-security

maya: FYI the vuln scanner picked up three separate advisories this morning: kubelet privilege escalation (CVE-2026-1001), cert-manager TLS validation bug, and a critical path vuln in nginx-ingress upstream. Need a coordinated patch plan for this week — thinking canary -> ramp -> full, but we need to land RBAC changes and audit logging checks first. @samir @dinesh :eyes:
samir: +1. can we get a quick blast radius estimate? kubelet patch likely needs node agent restart, etcd and cert-manager may be control-plane changes. do we have a non-prod cluster we can stage on?
dinesh: Staging available in eu-west-1 (staging-2). I can run the upgrade there today and validate logs. For kubelet the recommended patch requires kubelet restart and kube-proxy rotation unless we use a cordon/drain flow. I can draft an upgrade playbook.
kevin: Important to note: cert-manager change touches webhook RBAC scopes. If we widen RBAC in the short term we must add strict audit logging to detect misuse. Suggest we enable audit-policy with requestBody capture for the webhook namespace during rollout.
zoe: How about KMS keys for cert-manager signing? The advisory mentions rotation. If we rotate we need to coordinate HSM/KMS access across clusters — could break cert issuance briefly. Ops can do a KMS key alias swap with a fallback key.
maya: Good call. Proposed schedule: today afternoon — staging validation; tomorrow morning — small canary (5 nodes) in prod; tomorrow afternoon — ramp to 50%; Wednesday — full. Add hold window of 30m between phases. Anyone oppose?
samir: Sounds fine. Need to add a preflight checklist: backup etcd snapshot, confirm controller-manager leader election health, image digests pinned, and a test probe for cert issuance. I'll add that to the playbook.
dinesh: I'll run staging today and paste logs. If we see any RBAC denies in audit logs, we revert RBAC changes and fallback to old cert-manager image.
kevin: For KMS: I'll coordinate with cloud security to provision a temporary key alias and update IAM policy to allow cert-manager service account decrypt. We'll keep old key active until after verification.
maya: On the monitoring side, let's add temporary alert rules: increased 5xx rate on ingress, failed cert renewals, and any audit log RBAC.DENY spikes. Tag all alerts with #sec-patch.
deploy-bot: Security advisory recorded: advisory-2026-03, linked issues #4321 #4322. Automated CVE tracker created and assigned to @dinesh.
zoe: One more thing — rolling restart strategy: prefer pod disruption budget-aware drains, use `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` in canary, and run `kubectl cordon` then drain to minimize users impacted. I'll add commands to the playbook snippet.
maya: Thanks all. Samir, can you own the playbook merge? Dinesh run staging and report by EOD. Kevin manage KMS rotation plan. I'll schedule the canary and notify on-call.
samir: Will do. I'll open PR and link the preflight checklist.
dinesh: Staging run started, pinging results in ~2h.
kevin: KMS key alias created in sandbox, will request prod approval after staging.
maya: Great. If anyone finds a blocker call it out ASAP — otherwise we proceed with the proposed timeline. :+1:
